titleEn: Go Gently on the Shore Rocks!

pages.text: "Catch me, Kkiruk!" Dari hopped across the shore rocks. The roof gull called, "Wet rocks are slippery!" Dari ignored it. "Faster is more fun!"
"All the way to the farthest rock!" Dari hopped without looking. Slippery green moss covered the rocks. Kkiruk flapped. "Slow down! Look ahead!"
A flipper landed on moss and slid! Dari tipped, thumping his tummy on a rock. "Ouch!" His heart pounded. He had nearly fallen into the sea.
Mom hurried over. "Are you okay? Where did you bump?" She gently rubbed his tummy. Dari lowered his head. "I didn't see the moss..."
Mom pointed to two rocks. "Green moss is slippery. Dry gray rock is firm. Go around the green." Dari pressed a flipper on gray rock. No slipping.
Mom taught three promises. "One, look ahead! Two, avoid green moss! Three, go gently on the shore rocks!" Dari repeated her.
This time, Dari looked and moved gently, going around green patches. Kkiruk echoed from the roof. A wave splashed ahead! Dari stopped and waited for it to pass.
He reached the last rock without falling! Dari slapped his tail happily. "Slow lets me see every green patch!" Kkiruk landed beside him and clapped their wings.
Next day, Dari chose only dry gray rocks and moved slowly, belly low. Around the green patches! "One, look ahead! Two, avoid green moss! Three, go gently!"
Mom rested her chin on Dari's back. "You did wonderfully going slowly!" Staying upright was more fun than going fast. "Go gently on the shore rocks!" His tummy didn't hurt now.
